facts.activity_file: loading, restraining and placarding a load

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.title: preventive action - alarm philosophy conformance on LA-7201

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment on LA-7201 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in transporting materials by road, specifically loading, restraining and placarding a load. LA-7201 (marine loading arms) is in service for ship loading. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment had degraded below its design intent. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 27 November 2025 a corrective action on LA-7201 at Cape Verity Export Terminal was reviewed against the material unwanted event control it was raised to restore.
